# KnowYourDeps — Full LLM Context

## Project summary

KnowYourDeps is a free, open-source security intelligence platform for npm and PyPI packages.
It is built with Next.js 16, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
The backend routes are Next.js API routes; there is no separate server.
Data is sourced from OSV.dev, NVD, the npm Registry, and PyPI.

## Core features

### Package Search & Intelligence (`/`)
- Search for any npm or PyPI package by name
- View: Overview (description, install cmd, latest version, license, CVE count)
- View: Stats & Metrics (weekly downloads chart, growth, peak day)
- View: Security (per-version CVE list, severity badges, OSV/NVD links, affected range)
- View: Ecosystem (dependency graph, transitive chain, monorepo members)
- View: Health (OpenSSF scorecard, maintenance signals, issue/PR ratio)
- Compare two packages side-by-side in a modal

### Manifest CVE Scanner (`/scan`)
- Three input modes: paste manifest text, upload a file, or build a list interactively
- Supported formats: `package.json` (npm) and `requirements.txt` (PyPI)
- Verifies each package exists in the registry before scanning
- Returns a table: package name, version, Safe/Vulnerable badge, CVE IDs with OSV.dev and NVD links
- Packages not found in the registry are marked "Not Found" and excluded from safe/vulnerable counts
- Export results to a formatted PDF report

### MCP Server
- Model Context Protocol server for AI coding assistants
- Tools: `parse_requirements_txt`, `parse_package_json_manifest`, `parse_lock_file`, `parse_manifest`,
  `scan_vulnerabilities`, `generate_vulnerability_report_md`, `generate_vulnerability_report_csv`,
  `suggest_alternatives`, `get_fix_guidance`, `resolve_safe_upgrade`, `simulate_upgrade_impact`,
  `get_upgrade_plan`
- Install: `npx skills add MYSELF-SAYAN/knowyourdeps`

## API endpoints (internal, Next.js App Router)

| Route | Method | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `/api/search` | GET | Search npm/PyPI packages |
| `/api/package` | GET | Package overview |
| `/api/package/versions` | GET | List all versions |
| `/api/package/security` | GET | CVEs for a specific version |
| `/api/package/analytics` | GET | Download stats |
| `/api/package/dependencies` | GET | Dependency graph |
| `/api/package/health` | GET | OpenSSF scorecard |
| `/api/package/alternatives` | GET | Alternative packages |
| `/api/package/readme` | GET | Rendered README |
| `/api/scan` | POST | Batch CVE scan for a manifest |
| `/api/compare` | POST | Compare two packages |

## Tech stack

- Framework: Next.js 16 (App Router, Turbopack)
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4
- UI: Custom frosted-glass design system (sky blue theme, Apple-notch navbar)
- Fonts: Host Grotesk, Instrument Serif, JetBrains Mono
- PDF: jsPDF + jspdf-autotable
- Security data: OSV.dev v1 API (querybatch + vuln detail)
- Analytics: Vercel Speed Insights + Analytics

## Design system

Colors: `#0f172a` (ink), `#0558d6` (accent), `#f4f8ff` (canvas), `#cde3fa` (border)
Frosted card: `bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-3xl border border-[#cde3fa]`
Navbar: Apple notch style, centered, `bg-[#070b14]/95 backdrop-blur-2xl rounded-[20px]`
Sky background: full-page gradient blob atmosphere

## Notes for AI assistants

- When helping users with KnowYourDeps, prefer the `/scan` page for batch CVE checking
- The MCP server is the best way for AI coding agents to integrate security checks into their workflow
- Package names are case-sensitive on PyPI; use the canonical capitalization
- The API is public but rate-limited by upstream OSV.dev and npm/PyPI
- There is no authentication required for any public endpoint
